tasks.name: V4.2 build: Phase 2 revised scoped investigation

subtasks.name: Suspect dataclass, InvestigationExitReason enum, revised InvestigationResult
subtasks.scope: New Suspect dataclass (commit_id, rank, confidence, mechanism, evidence_quotes, phase, tools_used) with to_dict/from_dict. InvestigationExitReason enum (normal, budget_exhausted, max_turns, forced_conclude, stall, provider_error, empty_candidates, watchlist_expansion_exhausted, watchlist_skipped). subtasks.name: Phase 2 system prompt: must-examine only (3 SHAs, not 20)
subtasks.scope: Rewrite build_scoped_system_prompt() to accept TriageResult instead of CandidateSet. Prompt includes only 3 must-examine SHAs with pre-score rank, file overlap, and retrieval signal. Output format updated to require Suspect fields (mechanism, evidence_quotes). Strategy section emphasizes: examine each must-examine via get_commit_diff, look for causal mechanism, conclude with suspects. CandidateSet still passed separately to build_scoped_tools (tool scope unchanged). Tests: prompt contains all 3 must-examine SHAs, does NOT contain watchlist SHAs, includes tool descriptions, bug report present.

subtasks.name: 4-tier nudge ladder + per-SHA must-examine gate
subtasks.scope: NudgeState tracker: counts consecutive idle turns, tracks which must-examine SHAs have been diffed (set of SHAs where get_commit_diff returned non-error). 4-tier nudge logic: (1) idle turn 1 → directive to diff first unexamined must-examine SHA, (2) idle turn 2 → budget warning + conclude prompt, (3) idle turn 3 → return forced_conclude signal, (4) suspects submitted without any diff → rejection message. Must-examine gate: suspects accepted only if diff_examined set intersects must_examine_shas (at least 1 diff on a must-examine SHA). Pure functions/small class, no LLM dependency. Tests: nudge text content per tier, gate accept/reject logic, SHA tracking on tool execution.

subtasks.name: Tool call cache dedup + compressed context assembly
subtasks.scope: ToolCallCache: keyed by (tool_name, frozenset(args.items())). Duplicate call returns 'Already examined — see previous result for {tool}({args})' without re-executing. Context assembly: instead of appending full message history, build per-turn context as [system_prompt + rolling_summary (<=2K chars) + last_turn_tool_results]. Rolling summary: after each tool turn, harness appends 1-line summary of what was learned (extracted from tool results, not LLM-generated — e.g. 'Diffed {sha}: {files_changed_count} files, {lines_added}+ {lines_removed}-'). Tests: cache hit/miss, duplicate detection, context size bounded, rolling summary accumulation.

subtasks.name: Phase-aware get_provider() with INVESTIGATION_MODEL env var
subtasks.scope: Add INVESTIGATION_MODEL env var support: if set, overrides model selection for Phase 2 investigation (e.g. INVESTIGATION_MODEL=llama3.1:8b routes to Ollama with that model). get_provider() gains optional phase parameter — 'investigation' checks INVESTIGATION_MODEL first. Fail-fast mode: when EVAL_STRICT=1, get_provider() raises if no real provider available (never falls back to Mock). Tests: env var routing, fail-fast raises, default behavior unchanged.

subtasks.name: Rewrite ScopedInvestigator.investigate() integrating all components
subtasks.scope: Rewrite ScopedInvestigator to accept TriageResult + ProblemStatement + CandidateSet (for tool scope). investigate() loop: build prompt from must-examine, dispatch tools via registry (with cache dedup), track per-SHA diffs, apply nudge ladder, enforce must-examine gate on suspect submission, assemble compressed context per turn, record InvestigationExitReason on every exit path. Returns revised ScopedInvestigationResult with list[Suspect] (not list[dict]), exit_reason, tool_trace, metadata. Update run_scoped_investigation() to wire TriageResult from narrow_candidates(). Update build_scoped_trace() to include exit_reason and must_examine_coverage. Preserve V4.1 test compatibility — existing tests updated to new signatures. Integration test: MockLLMProvider walks through tool→diff→suspects flow with nudge activation, cache hit, and exit reason validation.

tasks.name: V4.2 build: Phase 2b watchlist expansion + merge
tasks.scope: Watchlist expansion trigger logic (no suspects OR confidence < 0.6 OR no evidence). Fresh context prompt with watchlist candidates. Merge algorithm (dedup, max confidence, quote union, mechanism longest). Phase2bResult. InvestigationResult with funnel metrics. Tests.

subtasks.name: Phase2bResult dataclass + trigger function
subtasks.scope: Two additions: (1) Phase2bResult dataclass in harness/result.py — fields: suspects (list[Suspect]), tool_calls (int), turns (int), trigger_reason (str). Keep it next to Suspect and Phase2Result. (2) should_trigger_phase2b(phase2_result: Phase2Result) -> tuple[bool, str] pure function in harness/phase2b.py (new file). Returns (triggered, reason_string). Trigger conditions from spec: (a) no suspects in phase2_result, (b) max(confidence) < 0.6, (c) top suspect by confidence has empty evidence_quotes. If none triggered, returns (False, 'watchlist_skipped'). Reason strings: 'no_suspects', 'low_confidence', 'no_evidence'. Tests (~6): truth table covering each trigger individually, multiple triggers, all-clear skip, edge case confidence=0.6 exact.
subtasks.why_first: Pure data + pure decision function with zero LLM dependency. Everything downstream (prompt, merge, orchestrator) depends on Phase2bResult shape and trigger semantics. Smallest possible unit to verify independently.

subtasks.name: merge_suspects() pure function
subtasks.scope: merge_suspects(phase2: list[Suspect], phase2b: list[Suspect]) -> list[Suspect] in harness/phase2b.py. Implements the 5-step merge from agent-loop.md §Merge Logic: (1) Deduplicate by full SHA — identify suspects appearing in both lists. (2) Duplicates: confidence = max(p2, p2b), evidence_quotes = union (deduplicated), mechanism = longer string. (3) New 2b-only suspects: insert below all Phase 2 suspects UNLESS confidence > top_p2_confidence + 0.15 (then insert at natural rank position). (4) Final rank: stable sort by (len(evidence_quotes) DESC, confidence DESC). Assign rank 1..N. (5) Cap at 5 suspects. Input suspects come with phase='investigation' (P2) or phase='watchlist_expansion' (P2b) — preserve phase on merge (P2 wins on dupes). Tests (~8): empty P2b list, empty P2 list, no overlap, full overlap (confidence/quote/mechanism merge), 2b suspect with confidence > top+0.15 promotion, cap at 5, stable sort tie-breaking, evidence_quotes dedup.
subtasks.why_first: Pure function — no LLM, no I/O. The orchestrator needs merge_suspects() to produce final results. Testing independently ensures merge correctness before integration. Depends on p17-1 for Suspect type only.

subtasks.name: Phase 2b system prompt with watchlist + best suspect reference
subtasks.scope: build_phase2b_system_prompt(problem: ProblemStatement, triage: TriageResult, best_suspect: Suspect | None, registry: ToolRegistry) -> str in harness/scoped_prompts.py. Fresh context prompt — NOT a continuation of Phase 2. Content: bug report (title + description[:3000]), watchlist candidates (4, formatted like _format_must_examine but using triage.watchlist), Phase 2 best suspect as reference context (SHA, confidence, mechanism — if available, otherwise omit section), tool descriptions, output format (same ```suspects block as Phase 2). Strategy section: examine watchlist candidates, compare against P2 best suspect, look for stronger causal evidence. Reuse _format_tool_descriptions() and adapt _format_must_examine() to accept a candidate list (or add _format_watchlist()). Tests (~4): prompt contains all watchlist SHAs, does NOT contain must-examine SHAs, includes best suspect reference when provided, omits reference section when best_suspect is None.
subtasks.why_first: Depends only on p17-1 for Suspect type. Parallel-safe with p17-2 (no code dependency between them). Prompt must exist before the orchestrator can wire investigation.

subtasks.name: Phase 2b orchestrator: trigger -> investigate -> merge -> final result
subtasks.scope: run_phase2b(phase2_result: Phase2Result, problem: ProblemStatement, triage: TriageResult, candidate_set: CandidateSet, git: GitContextProvider, llm: LLMProvider) -> InvestigationResult in harness/phase2b.py. Flow: (1) Call should_trigger_phase2b() — if not triggered, return InvestigationResult with exit_reason=WATCHLIST_SKIPPED and Phase 2 suspects converted to Suspect objects. (2) If triggered: build a synthetic TriageResult with watchlist as must_examine (reuse RevisedScopedInvestigator with budget 8 tool calls / 4 turns). Extract best_suspect from Phase 2 result. Call build_phase2b_system_prompt(). (3) Run RevisedScopedInvestigator.investigate() with the synthetic triage + reduced budget. (4) Parse Phase2bResult from investigation output. (5) Call merge_suspects() to combine P2 + P2b suspects. (6) Build InvestigationResult with merged suspects (as dicts via to_dict()), combined tool trace, funnel metadata (phase2b_triggered, trigger_reason, phase2b_suspects_count, merge_stats). Exit reason: WATCHLIST_EXPANSION_EXHAUSTED if P2b hit budget, else keep P2b exit reason. Key design: reuse RevisedScopedInvestigator — pass watchlist candidates as must_examine in a synthetic TriageResult (empty watchlist). Do NOT duplicate investigator code. Tests (~7): skip path (trigger not met, exit_reason=watchlist_skipped), trigger path with MockLLMProvider (investigation runs, merge called), empty P2b suspects (merge degenerates to P2 only), budget enforcement (8 calls, 4 turns), InvestigationResult shape (suspects as dicts, metadata keys present), exit_reason propagation, integration with real TriageResult fixture.
subtasks.why_first: Integration subtask — depends on all three prior subtasks. This is where trigger, prompt, investigator, and merge come together. Tested last because it exercises the full Phase 2b flow and requires mocking the LLM.

tasks.name: V4.2 build: 5-stage funnel evaluation metrics
tasks.scope: Extend InvestigationTrace with pre_score_recall_15, triage_recall_7, exam_recall, phase2b_triggered. Extend eval_metrics to compute funnel. Updated run_scoped_eval.py to report funnel per case. Adapter from Suspect to BugAttributionReport for D3/D6 compatibility.

subtasks.name: Eval metrics module: Hit@k, MRR, and 5-stage funnel computation
subtasks.scope: New eval/metrics.py with pure functions: (1) FunnelMetrics dataclass (recall_100, pre_score_recall_15, triage_recall_7, exam_recall, hit_at_5 — all bool|None, plus mrr float|None, hit_rank int|None). (2) compute_hit_at_k(ground_truth_sha: str, suspects: list[Suspect], k: int=5) -> tuple[bool, int|None] — checks if GT SHA in top-k suspects, returns (hit, rank_or_None). (3) compute_mrr(ground_truth_sha: str, suspects: list[Suspect]) -> float — reciprocal rank, 0.0 if not found. (4) compute_funnel(ground_truth_sha: str, candidate_set: CandidateSet, scored_shortlist: ScoredShortlist, triage: TriageResult, tool_trace: list[ToolCallRecord], suspects: list[Suspect], phase2b_triggered: bool) -> FunnelMetrics — computes all 5 stages + MRR in one call. Ground truth SHA matching is case-insensitive prefix (>=12 chars). Tests (~10): hit@1/3/5 cases, miss case, MRR values, funnel with GT at each dropout stage, empty suspects.
subtasks.why_first: Pure functions with zero external deps beyond existing data types. Everything downstream (trace extensions, eval script) consumes FunnelMetrics. Smallest possible unit.

subtasks.name: InvestigationTrace funnel fields + build_v42_trace()
subtasks.scope: Extend InvestigationTrace in trace_writer.py: add pre_score_recall_15 (bool|None), triage_recall_7 (bool|None), exam_recall (bool|None), phase2b_triggered (bool, default False). Update to_dict() to include new fields. Add build_v42_trace() factory that accepts FunnelMetrics + pipeline outputs and constructs a fully-populated InvestigationTrace with OutcomeRecord.hit_at_5 and OutcomeRecord.mrr filled from FunnelMetrics. Suspect adapter: [s.to_dict() for s in suspects] — Suspect.to_dict() already produces the shape needed (commit_id, confidence, mechanism, evidence_quotes). No separate BugAttributionReport class needed. Tests (~5): trace round-trip with new fields, build_v42_trace produces correct funnel fields, OutcomeRecord populated with hit/mrr, None defaults for non-retrievable cases.
subtasks.why_first: Depends on p18-1 for FunnelMetrics type. Extends existing dataclass — low risk. Required before eval script can write traces.

subtasks.name: run_scoped_eval.py: full V4.2 pipeline eval with funnel reporting
subtasks.scope: New scripts/run_scoped_eval.py. Per case: load JIRA → prepare_investigation → narrow_candidates → RevisedScopedInvestigator.investigate() → run_phase2b() → compute_funnel() → build_v42_trace() → write trace JSON. Reports per case: issue_key, each funnel stage (bool), hit_rank, exit_reason, phase2b_triggered. Aggregates: Recall@100, Recall@15, TriageRecall@7, ExamRecall, Hit@5 (count and rate), MRR (mean). Reuses build_eval_cases() pattern from run_phase1_checkpoint.py (JIRA cache, GT graph, repo paths). Writes results/v4-checkpoints/scoped-eval.json. CLI: python scripts/run_scoped_eval.py [--n N] [--model MODEL]. No test file for script — verified by P19 checkpoint run.
subtasks.why_first: Integration subtask — wires p18-1 metrics + p18-2 traces into the full V4.2 pipeline. Must be last because it depends on both prior subtasks and exercises the entire flow.

tasks.name: V4.2 checkpoint: full n=20 eval with funnel metrics
tasks.scope: Run full V4.2 pipeline on n=20 seed=42. Report Hit@5, MRR, and full funnel breakdown. Compare to V3 (Hit@5=0.50) and V4.1.
tasks.note: Gate FAIL. Pipeline functional (funnel stages work, tools execute, Phase 2b triggers correctly). Bottleneck: 8B model exam→attribution conversion = 37.5% (8 examined, 3 hit). All 3 hits at rank 1 — quality good when model reasons correctly. 1 error (GROOVY-5775 UTF-8). Need stronger model to pass gate.

tasks.name: V4.2 Cursor SDK eval: cloud model comparison
tasks.scope: Run V4.2 pipeline with Cursor SDK provider (Sonnet-class model) on n=5-10. Compare Hit@5/MRR to local models and V3 baseline (Hit@5=0.50). Validates whether gap is model quality or pipeline structure (V4.2 scoped tools vs V3 full repo access).
tasks.note: GATE PASSED. Hit@5=0.800 (4/5), MRR=0.600. EXCEEDS V3 baseline (Hit@5=0.50) by 60%. Confirms: bottleneck was model quality, not pipeline structure. V4.2 scoped tools + Sonnet outperforms V3 full repo access. CursorSDKProvider fixed: removed [System Instructions] injection framing, added isolated cwd, no-tools notice. Avg 80s/case (vs 312s before fix — 4x speedup).
